# Configuration reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_docs.py from netdoctor.settings; do not edit by hand. -->

NetDoctor reads an optional TOML file (`--config FILE`). **Precedence:** built-in defaults < config file < command-line flags.

- **Strict:** an unknown section or key is an error, with a "did you mean" hint. Nothing is silently ignored.
- **Secrets:** use `env:NAME` references and `*_env` keys instead of putting secrets in the file. If a file holds an inline webhook URL and is readable by other users, NetDoctor logs a warning.
- **Shared files:** `[watch]`, `[webhook]` and `[metrics]` keys are inert in one-shot runs, so one file serves both a cron job and the monitor. (A watch-only *flag* without `--watch` is an error.)
- `targets = [...]` at the top level lists targets; targets given on the command line replace them.
- Check the result with `netdoctor --config FILE --print-config` (inline webhook URLs are redacted).

See [`examples/netdoctor.toml`](../examples/netdoctor.toml) for a complete annotated file.

## `[checks]`

| Key | Type | Default | CLI flag | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timeout` | number | `5` | `--timeout` | Timeout in seconds for every individual network operation. |
| `samples` | integer | `5` | `--samples` | TCP connect (and ICMP) samples per endpoint, 1-50. More samples give better jitter and loss estimates. |
| `workers` | integer | `4` | `--workers` | Targets diagnosed in parallel, 1-32. |
| `icmp` | boolean | `true` | `--icmp / --no-icmp` | Run the system `ping` as a secondary cross-check. |
| `traceroute` | boolean | `false` | `--traceroute / --no-traceroute` | Also run traceroute (slow). |
| `dns_compare` | boolean | `true` | `--dns-compare / --no-dns-compare` | Cross-check DNS against public resolvers. `false` disables **all** third-party lookups (UDP and DoH). |
| `resolvers` | list of strings | `["1.1.1.1", "8.8.8.8"]` | `--resolver (repeatable)` | Public UDP resolvers (IP addresses) for the cross-check. |
| `doh_servers` | list of strings | *(unset)* | `--doh, --doh-server (repeatable)` | RFC 8484 DNS-over-HTTPS endpoints (`https://` URLs) for an encrypted cross-check. |
| `ca_bundle` | string | *(unset)* | `--ca-bundle` | PEM file of trusted CAs used *instead of* the system store (corporate TLS inspection). Relative paths resolve against the config file. |
| `max_redirects` | integer | `5` |  | Maximum HTTP redirects followed (0-20). |

## `[thresholds]`

| Key | Type | Default | CLI flag | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latency_warn_ms` | number | `250` |  | TCP connect latency above this raises `HIGH_LATENCY`. |
| `jitter_warn_ms` | number | `30` |  | Jitter above this raises `HIGH_JITTER`. |
| `ttfb_warn_ms` | number | `1500` |  | Time to first byte above this raises `SLOW_RESPONSE`. |
| `dns_warn_ms` | number | `500` |  | System DNS lookup time above this raises `DNS_SLOW`. |
| `cert_expiry_warn_days` | integer | `14` |  | Certificates expiring within this many days raise `TLS_EXPIRING_SOON`. |

## `[output]`

| Key | Type | Default | CLI flag | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | one of `text`, `markdown`, `json`, `html`, `prometheus` | `text` | `-f / --format, --json` | Report format. Watch mode supports `text` and `json` (JSON Lines). |
| `color` | one of `auto`, `always`, `never` | `auto` | `--color` | ANSI colour in text output (`NO_COLOR` is honoured). |
| `ascii` | boolean | `false` | `--ascii` | ASCII symbols instead of Unicode. |
| `file` | string | *(unset)* | `-o / --out` | Write the report here (atomically; appended in watch mode). Relative paths resolve against the config file. |
| `mode` | octal mode string | `600` | `--out-mode` | Permissions for newly created report files, as an octal string. Default `600` (owner only), because reports list internal hostnames and findings. Use `640` or `644` deliberately, e.g. so the Prometheus textfile collector (another user) can read it. World-writable modes are refused. |

## `[logging]`

| Key | Type | Default | CLI flag | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `verbose` | integer | `0` | `-v / -vv` | 0 = warnings, 1 = info, 2 = debug. |
| `format` | one of `text`, `json` | `text` | `--log-format` | `json` emits one JSON object per log line, for SIEM ingestion. |
| `file` | string | *(unset)* | `--log-file` | Append logs to this file instead of stderr. |

## `[watch]`

| Key | Type | Default | CLI flag | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` | `-w / --watch` | Behave as `--watch`. Other `[watch]`, `[webhook]` and `[metrics]` keys are ignored in one-shot runs. |
| `interval` | number | `30` | `--interval` | Seconds between runs (minimum 1). Pick a value comfortably above `timeout`. |
| `max_runs` | integer | *(unset)* | `--max-runs` | Stop after N runs (default: until interrupted). |
| `heartbeat` | number | `0` | `--heartbeat` | Emit a `heartbeat` event for unchanged targets every N seconds (0 = off). |
| `confirm` | integer | `1` | `--confirm` | Report a change only after N consecutive sightings (flap damping, 1-20). |

## `[webhook]`

| Key | Type | Default | CLI flag | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | *(unset)* | `--webhook` | Destination `https://` URL, or `env:NAME` to read it from an environment variable. **The URL is a secret** (e.g. Slack tokens); prefer `env:`. |
| `kind` | one of `generic`, `slack` | `generic` | `--webhook-format` | `generic` (signed JSON) or `slack` (Slack-compatible text; also works with Mattermost). |
| `events` | list of strings | `["change", "recovered", "error"]` | `--notify-on` | Which events to send: `initial`, `change`, `recovered`, `heartbeat`, `error`. |
| `secret_env` | string | *(unset)* | `--webhook-secret-env` | Name of the environment variable holding the HMAC-SHA256 signing key. If omitted, `NETDOCTOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is used when set. |
| `allow_private` | boolean | `false` | `--webhook-allow-private` | Permit private/loopback/link-local destinations. **Disables SSRF protection.** |
| `allow_http` | boolean | `false` | `--webhook-allow-http` | Permit plain `http://` destinations. |
| `include_report` | boolean | `false` | `--webhook-include-report` | Include the full per-target report in generic payloads. |

## `[metrics]`

| Key | Type | Default | CLI flag | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `port` | integer | *(unset)* | `--metrics-port` | Serve Prometheus metrics at `/metrics` (and `/healthz`) on this port in watch mode. `0` picks a free port. |
| `bind` | string | `127.0.0.1` | `--metrics-bind` | Address to bind. Non-loopback addresses without a token trigger a warning. |
| `token_env` | string | *(unset)* | `--metrics-token-env` | Name of the environment variable holding a bearer token. If omitted, `NETDOCTOR_METRICS_TOKEN` is used when set. |
